# Independent review: Gaussian latent source

Reviewed candidate: `REPORT_2026-09-15_GAUSSIAN_LATENT_SOURCE.md`  
SHA256: `c05bb5d1170ab9927c0a80255deaa21cdd8a704cf1f01d6b45e2f1e03d67420d`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_SCOPED_GAUSSIAN_LATENT_REPRESENTATION_AND_LIPSCHITZ_FILTERS_ONLY.**

The `4N`-Gaussian construction produces the exact finite gamma law, and the
Mellin/cosine formula has the correct powers and strip.  For interior
critical-strip imaginary part, its integrand vanishes at the Gaussian origin,
which rules out equality with a finite globally-Lipschitz exponential sum.

The radial Gamma/Dirichlet factorization is exact.  The sphere calculation
has the correct Rayleigh-quotient maximum and gives
`Lip(log Q_N)=N-1/N`.  The scaling limit `2N Q_N -> T` follows by radial
concentration and the almost-sure gamma-series limit.

The exponential-tail transport lemma for `H_N` correctly excludes finite
standard-Gaussian pushforwards through globally Lipschitz real maps, including
positive globally log-Lipschitz reweightings.  It does not exclude other
Gaussian representations, nonlinear/non-Lipschitz maps, the geometric family,
or supply C6, V-sign, or RH.

findings: Exact arithmetic transform as a Gaussian integral in 4N dimensions
Exact radial gamma integration and compact Dirichlet angular factor
Direct latent integrand vanishes at origin in interior critical strip; cannot be pointwise exponential of finite global Lipschitz sum
Scaled angular variable 2N Q_N converges in probability to the original full gamma sum T
Arithmetic H_N cannot be pushforward of finite Gaussian by globally Lipschitz real map, including positive globally log-Lipschitz reference reweighting
route_decision: Second bounded preflight of the same Barvinok small-global-interaction implementation. Park direct affine, natural latent exponential, and positive global-Lipschitz Gaussian-transport routes. Do not open a third renamed budget task.
